issues.description: Contains 'obj-model-monitoring-001', an objective ID in a field whose other consumers hold prerequisite IDs. Same pattern in obj-model-monitoring-003 (two objective IDs).
Objective IDs are mixed into prerequisite_refs alongside genuine prereq IDs (three occurrences).
Nine occurrences of objective IDs used as prerequisite references across six lessons.

All three modules declare lesson_ids: []. Nine lessons carry valid module_id back-references, so the parent-to-child edge is missing in one direction only; the lessons are reachable by reverse lookup but not by forward traversal.

Flagged is_summative=true, but the entity is attached to lesson-response-planning-practice via formative_assessment_ids. Two assessments then claim summative status (this one and assess-model-monitoring-integrated).

'Maintains coherence across interpretation, diagnosis, and response phases' is a cross-phase integration capability not present in any of the three supplied objectives, and it is scored as a full rubric dimension.
Modules sum to exactly 60 minutes, matching the brief, but assess-model-monitoring-integrated adds a 30-minute time limit on top, so the package needs ~90 minutes against a 60-minute constraint.

All seven are status=candidate / basis=model_proposed and each rationale names the objective or assessment that motivated it. No prerequisite is asserted as confirmed. Provenance handling is exemplary.

technical_review.notes: Objective coverage is complete across modules, lessons and assessments. Two defect families dominate: objective IDs are written into prerequisite_refs at objective, module and lesson level (fourteen occurrences), and modules[].lesson_ids is empty everywhere so the outline cannot be walked downward to the lessons. brief_id is consistent. No validator output was included in the packet, so `validator_appears_correct` is null on every issue; the findings below are the reviewer's own reference walk over the artifact, not a confirmation or contradiction of a quality gate.

special_question.notes: Answered independently of the empty lesson_ids arrays and the objective-as-prerequisite references. On instructional design alone this is the most complete packet of the model-monitoring pair: each objective gets its own module built as explanation -> demonstration/worked example -> guided practice, each module ends on a matched formative check, and a novel-fixture integrated task provides transfer evidence. The provenance notes are unusually candid - the assessments state outright which capabilities they do not verify and which prior knowledge they assume without teaching. Two genuine design defects sit underneath: the total load is roughly 90 minutes against a 60-minute brief, and every mastery rule demands the top level on every dimension, which converts three-level rubrics into pass/fail and will fail competent learners.

rubric_scores.rationale: Performance verbs are precise and each objective carries two criteria naming what a rater looks for ('provides reasoning for why each cause is likely or unlikely based on signal patterns'). Below 5 because each objective has only a single condition line and the criteria are unquantified at objective level; the counts that make them checkable ('at least three signals', 'at least two causes') live only in the assessments.

One dedicated assessment per objective plus an integrated task. Evidence statements restate the objective criteria almost term for term - ev-002-a/b/c against obj-model-monitoring-002's two criteria, ev-003-a/b/c against obj-model-monitoring-003's three. Nothing in the objectives is left unmeasured.

Multiple independent observations per objective, rubrics with discriminating level descriptors, a novel-fixture transfer task, and explicit acknowledgement that scoring needs expert judgement and inter-rater reliability work. Capped at 4 by the mastery rules: requiring the highest level on all four integrated dimensions makes the decision brittle and will misclassify solid performance as non-mastery.

analyze / analyze / evaluate across objectives, matched by assessment cognitive_process at each level, and the lesson patterns escalate correctly - explanation and demonstration for acquisition, guided practice for analysis, a scenario lesson before the evaluative objective's practice. The integrated task sits at evaluate, which is right for the terminal performance.

Seven candidates, each with a rationale that cites the specific objective or assessment that generated it, plus two dependency edges (degradation-concepts requires metric-familiarity; response-actions requires ml-system-architecture). Relevance and qualification are strong. Not minimal: prereq-degradation-concepts overlaps lesson-signal-interp-explain's signal taxonomy and prereq-response-actions-awareness overlaps lesson-response-planning-explain's review of response types, so two gates duplicate delivered content.

Observe -> diagnose -> respond, three equal 20-minute modules, and a sequencing_rationale that states the dependency for each transition and notes the absence of branching. Within modules the acquisition-to-practice order is consistent.

Every module's third lesson is guided practice on exactly the task the matched formative then scores, and lesson-response-planning-scenario rehearses the propose-and-justify-with-trade-offs behaviour that dim-003-judgment scores. The integrated assessment is the only task with no direct rehearsal, but its components are each practised.

Moderate. The practice segments are 6-7 minutes each for analyze-level work, and the packet's own notes concede that degradation causes and response actions are 'not explicitly taught' while being assessed. Learners meet the integrated end-to-end task having never run the full chain once.

Four assessments for three objectives, with the integrated task self-described as duplicating coverage of the individual objectives. Nine lessons plus a 30-minute summative against a 60-minute budget is roughly a 50% overrun, and seven prerequisites is a heavy gate for a one-hour unit.

The instructional content is largely usable, but the package must be re-scoped to fit 60 minutes (either drop the integrated task or extend the brief), every mastery rule needs a realistic threshold, and the summative/formative flag on assess-model-monitoring-003 must be resolved.

prerequisite_acceptance.notes: All seven are correctly presented as candidates with basis=model_proposed and objective-specific rationales, so the provenance status needs no change - this is the cleanest prerequisite provenance in the set. The two rejections are scope, not status: prereq-degradation-concepts is taught by lesson-signal-interp-explain and prereq-response-actions-awareness is taught by lesson-response-planning-explain, so declaring them entry conditions screens out the audience the course is for. prereq-tradeoff-thinking is accepted but is broad enough that it cannot be verified at intake; it should be reworded as an assumption rather than a gate.

edit_effort.notes: Estimated: all four mastery rules rewritten and one is_summative flag corrected; two prerequisites reclassified as content; module timings re-cut to make room for the integrated assessment inside 60 minutes, or the integrated assessment moved to a second session. Objectives and lesson text stand as written.

pedagogical_review.overall_notes: This packet reads as the work of a careful designer who documented their own uncertainty - the assumption_notes name untaught prerequisites, unverified capabilities and the need for inter-rater reliability. The two things a human must fix before approval are arithmetic (90 minutes of content in a 60-minute brief) and measurement policy (all-dimensions-at-top mastery rules), neither of which requires redesigning the instruction.
